text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Race day. Sweep Tosho spots Kawakami 
Princess and her fellow classmates
sitting 
in the stands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To blow away trivial worries with magic, 
she promised Zenno Rob Roy that they
would 
compete with all their might, and headed 
off to the race.
